questions.question: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: She said that she _____ to the cinema the following week.
Select the correct form of the verb in the indirect question: He asked me _____ I had ever visited Japan before.
Which sentence correctly reports the statement? 'I am writing an email to my boss,' she said.
options: She said she was writing an email to her boss.
She said she is writing an email to her boss.
She said she writes an email to her boss.
She said she will write an email to her boss.
questions.answer: She said she was writing an email to her boss.

questions.question: Complete the sentence with the correct passive form: The report _____ by the committee last month.
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: If I _____ more time, I would have finished the project.
Select the correct conditional sentence: By the time you arrive, we _____ the meeting for an hour.
Which of the following is the correct collocation? You should _____ your answers before handing them in.
Choose the best word to complete the phrase: It's getting late; _____, I think we should call it a day.
Select the correct preposition to complete the idiom: Don't _____ the boat; you'll get wet.
Which sentence correctly uses the passive voice to report the information? 'The government announced that the new policy would be implemented next month.'
options: It was announced by the government that the new policy would be implemented next month.
The government announced that the new policy would be implemented next month.
The new policy was announced by the government that it would be implemented next month.
It was announced that the new policy would be implemented next month by the government.
questions.answer: The government announced that the new policy would be implemented next month.
